title: OpenMHS error registry (MHS/spec/errors.json)
description: The machine-readable error registry. Every record has one shape. MHS/spec/appendix-b-errors.md and the tables in mhs/errors.py are generated from it. driver_subset marks the small set of codes a driver or bridge may raise; every other code is produced by the runtime.

mhs_error_registry.description: Registry format and wire revision (codes are part of wire revision 1). Not a specification release: record 'since' values are spec_version releases.

jsonrpc_codes.description: Structural JSON-RPC codes used by the area (ERR-007).

status.description: Lifecycle, in the words capability classes use: stable (supported), deprecated (still registered and accepted; emit replaced_by), retired (kept for reference, never emitted), feature (a hello.features disclosure string, never emitted as an error). 'active' is the pre-0.9 spelling of stable, accepted for older registry copies.

since.description: OpenMHS specification release (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH of spec_version, e.g. 0.9.0) that registered the code with its current meaning; never later than spec_version. Independent of mhs_error_registry (the registry format and wire revision).

driver_subset.description: True for the codes drivers and bridges may raise (DriverFailed); the runtime emits the rest.

replaced_by.description: For a deprecated code: the code to emit instead.
